description: Set up the pnpm monorepo root structure with workspace configuration, shared tsconfig, turbo.json, .env.example, .gitignore, and all package/app directory scaffolding.
steps: Create root package.json with pnpm workspaces config, scripts for build/dev/lint across all packages
Create pnpm-workspace.yaml defining packages/* and apps/* workspaces
Create turbo.json with pipeline for build, dev, lint, test tasks with proper dependency ordering
Create root tsconfig.json as base config with strict mode, path aliases

Create .env.example with ALL environment variables needed across all apps: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, DATABASE_URL, R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET_NAME, R2_PUBLIC_URL, REDIS_URL, REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, WATERMARK_TEXT, INSIGHTFACE_MODEL_PATH
Create comprehensive .gitignore for Node, Rust/Tauri, .env files, node_modules, dist, .next, target
Create .npmrc with shamefully-hoist=true for pnpm compatibility
Create packages/database/package.json with prisma and @prisma/client deps
Create apps/api/package.json with NestJS deps (@nestjs/core, @nestjs/common, @nestjs/platform-express, @aws-sdk/client-s3, @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner, bullmq)
Create apps/desktop/package.json with React, Vite, @tauri-apps deps
Create apps/worker/package.json with NestJS, BullMQ, Sharp, node-insightface deps
Create apps/web/package.json with Next.js, React, tailwindcss deps
acceptance_criteria: Root pnpm-workspace.yaml correctly references packages/* and apps/*
All package.json files have proper name, version, dependencies listed
.env.example contains every env var needed by all services with descriptions
No hardcoded URLs or credentials anywhere
turbo.json defines build pipeline with correct topological dependencies
verification: Verify all expected files exist in the directory structure
Verify .env.example has at minimum 15 environment variables covering all services
Verify no hardcoded credentials or URLs in any file (grep for http:// and https:// should only find comments/docs)
findings: All 22 env vars in .env.example. No hardcoded URLs. turbo.json omits schema field due to tool restriction.
